correctness.rationale: For normalized monotone absolute Φ, max(a,b)<=Φ(a,b)<=Φ(1,1)max(a,b), so c=1 iff Φ is maximum. For maximum metric, a simplex of the product has vertex-witness criterion exactly when both projected simplices are witnessed. Every categorical simplicial product realization retracts by support-preserving barycentric map z_xy -> (sum_y z_xy)(sum_x z_xy), with linear homotopy preserving the allowed full rectangle and natural in the radius. Over a field, Künneth yields interval intersections. If c>1, the four corners of two 2-point unit factors have radius-1..c open stage of all proper subsets, the boundary of a tetrahedron S², with H2 interval [1,c); both factor complexes are a simplex at r>=1. This is an exact universal necessity witness and minimal size two points per factor.
